item.title: Remilia Quarterly Issue 1 Launch Rave!!!!
item.description: Beloved Readers, The first issue of Remilia Quarterly is here! To celebrate, the Remilia Corporation cordially invites you to attend our Remilia Quarterly Vol. 1 Launch Rave!!! this Friday, April 26, in Chicago, Illinois. There will be a very special live "reading"[1] featuring pieces by: BONKLE K. M. DRAGOVIC

item.title: Towards A New Net Art by Alexander Raubo [RQ 1-1]
item.description: Imagine a network, nodes connected by links, cables running across oceans, circuit boards flashing; picture the internet as back end infrastructure, as the dystopian grids and matrices of Gibsonian “cyberspace” and its nineteen-nineties insurrectionists, teenage hackers.

item.title: Let's All Love Remilia: Notes On Network Spirituality
item.description: "Remilia serves as vehicle for the emancipation of the faithful. This class of Network Spiritualist NEETs, through social and cryptocurrency media, attracts cultural and economic capital. Their agency abets the spread of Network Spirituality through Remilia’s New Internet."

item.title: Angelic Algorithms
item.description: We become angels when we log on through the constant merging of substances into an immaterial form that lives on... liquidated in the network. God constantly evolves out of itself; everything in movement and movement of change has its perfect form always already in God.
